StatDef.label: parry aptitude
StatDef.description:
How well this pawn can deflect an incoming melee attack with a held weapon.

This is aptitude, not the final chance. The attack is contested: a more skilled attacker is harder to parry. Attacks from behind cannot be parried at all, and a pawn can only parry a limited number of attacks in quick succession, so being swarmed remains dangerous.

Requires a weapon in hand.

StatDef.label: evasion
StatDef.description: Reduction to an attacker's chance to hit this pawn while it is moving.\n\nA stationary pawn does not evade. Evasion is a consequence of movement, so it trades away the ability to shoot back.

StatDef.label: suppression resistance
StatDef.description: How strongly this pawn resists suppression building up from incoming fire.\n\nHigher values mean the pawn keeps fighting under fire that would pin someone else down.
